+8 % Ausweichchance. Gut, wenn dich Gegn: +8 % dodge chance. Good when enemies are hitting you in melee, e.g. before level 10 or while taming.

After beta nerfs, according to Warcraft Tavern the weakest Alliance choice – according to other sources still good. According to Warcraft Tavern, though, all races are within about 1% damage.

10 % weniger erlittener und verursachter: 10 % less damage taken and dealt and, since Blizzard's note of 2.11., 80 % more threat (previously 30 %). Stance for tanking; via class quest.
16-Punkte-Talent: 30 Sek. lang werden de: 16-point talent: for 30 sec your party members are healed for 20 % of your Shadow damage on the target. Cooldown 30 sec according to the Oct. 15 beta build; can no longer be resisted. The healing cannot be a critical hit.
2/4/6/8/10 % Chance, nach einem Treffer: 2/4/6/8/10 % chance after a hit with a damage spell to enter a Clearcasting state: your next damage spell costs no mana. Ranks learned more than 12 levels earlier trigger less often. With Missile Barrage active, Arcane Missiles do not consume Clearcasting.
<b>Wichtig zum Stand</b>Forever startet: Current statusForever launches on November 5 at 0 h. Blizzard's notes of November 2 are included; the talent reworks for Rogue, Warrior and Shaman are announced but not yet in the beta client (columns partly estimated). Much of the info from level 30 on is based on beta and data analysis and may still change. Names marked * are new Forever content that had no official German name yet when this was written.
Ab Stufe 56 Tollkühne Schwünge* bei Wutm: From level 56, Reckless Swings* when you're short on rage – but it costs 25 % of your base health.
Alle 51 Punkte in Verstärkung. Dieselben: All 51 points in Enhancement. Same talents as for leveling, but Ancestral Knowledge comes earlier, because via Mental Dexterity* Intellect now gives 150 % of it as attack power. With a shield and Rockbiter also playable as a dungeon tank. Preliminary.
Alle Talent- und Fähigkeitswerte stammen: All talent and ability values come from the beta or Blizzard's developer notes of November 2. The talent rework is announced but not yet in the beta client – values and some column positions may still change before launch.
Alles zuerst in Kampf: mehr Treffer, meh: Everything into Combat first: more hit, more damage on Sinister Strike and Eviscerate, Blade Flurry at 30, Flash of Steel* for your Shank* and Adrenaline Rush at 40. After that you grab crit, energy and Lethality from the first tiers of Assassination (preliminary, talent rework announced).
Allgemein (2. Nov.): Mehr Schaden für al: General (Nov. 2): more damage for all classes, but higher-level enemies have more health. Talents no longer lose proc chance when you cast low spell ranks. New spells no longer land on the action bar automatically. Trainer costs 1–60 total about 206–207 gold.
Allgemein (2. Nov.): Neue Zauber landen: General (Nov. 2): new spells no longer land on your action bar automatically; all trainer costs from 1 to 60 together around 206–207 gold.
Allgemein (2.11.): Klassen machen mehr S: General (2.11.): classes deal more damage, while higher-level enemies have more health; new abilities no longer land on the action bar automatically; trainer costs 1–60 total about 206–207 gold; Tauren Warriors now correctly have +5 Strength compared to Humans (previously +2).
Allgemein: Neue Zauber landen nicht mehr: General: new spells no longer land on the action bar automatically; all trainer costs 1–60 together around 206–207 gold.
Als Bär (115 % mehr Bedrohung): Demorali: As a bear (115 % more threat): always keep Demoralizing Roar and Faerie Fire up, Lacerate to 5 stacks, Swipe against groups.
Als Heiler: Wasserschild nicht vergessen: As a healer: don't forget Water Shield, and put Riptide on the tank before Chain Heal (Riptide now only heals over time).
Als Schadensmacher: Warte, bis der Tank: As a damage dealer: wait until the tank has enough threat before you go all out – Blessing of Salvation no longer exists in Forever.
Als Tank Ziele markieren und Spott berei: As a tank, mark targets and keep Taunt ready; Defiance (up to +20 %) and Defensive Stance (+80 % threat since 2.11.) provide threat.
Als Tank: Siegel des Furors ist euer Spo: As a tank: Seal of Fury is your taunt via Judgement (10 m). Always keep Righteous Fury (+33 % threat, +90 % extra from Holy damage) on. Consecration hits the first 4 enemies hard – ideal for gathering packs.
Angekündigter Talent-Umbau (2.11., noch: Announced talent rework (2.11., not yet in the beta client, preliminary): Improved Tactical Mastery* 3 ranks (5/10/15 rage), Two-Handed Weapon Specialization 2/4/6 %, Bloodthrill* 2 ranks (10/20 %), Improved Slam reduces the cooldown by 2,5/5 sec.
Arkanschlag (2. Nov.): pro Stapel +100 %: Arcane Blast (Nov. 2): +100 % mana cost per stack (previously 175 %) and 12 % of Intellect as spell damage (previously 15 %), lasts 18 sec.
Aspekt des Falken gibt wieder 20/35/50/7: Aspect of the Hawk again gives 20/35/50/70/90/110 ranged attack power (Rank 1–6). Hunter's Mark no longer stacks across different ranks; the Rank 4 bug is fixed.
Auf den eingefrorenen Gegner: Verbrennun: On the frozen enemy: Combustion, then Ice Lance or Fire Blast (shared cooldown) and a fast Pyroblast (with Heating Up).
Aufschlitzen (Talent) auf 5 Stapel bring: Get Lacerate (talent) to 5 stacks and keep it there.
Aufschlitzen ist seit dem 2. Nov. ein Ta: Since Nov. 2, Lacerate is a talent in Feral Combat (tier 4) and is no longer learned by all Druids at the trainer.
Aura des Volltreffers sitzt jetzt in Rei: Trueshot Aura now sits in tier 4 (21 points) and only grants ranged attack power (since Nov. 2, 20/35/50/75/100 per rank).
Ausdauer (+5 % Gesundheit; laut Blizzard: Endurance (+5 % health; according to Blizzard's note of Nov. 2 without hit or crit bonus) and War Stomp (AoE stun). New: Plainsrunning* (speed buff before your first mount, now 2 % per stack up to 60 %). Considered the best race by gamer-guides.
Begleiter behalten ihre angeborenen Angr: Pets keep their innate attack speed bonuses even when untrained.
Beherrschung über Feuer und Blitz: Verri: Mastery over fire and lightning: for 15 sec reduces the cast time of Lightning Bolt by 0,5 sec and removes the cooldown of Chain Lightning. Instant, 3 min cooldown (formerly Elemental Mastery; preliminary).
Beim Haltungswechsel behältst du zusätzl: When switching stances you additionally keep up to 5/10/15 rage (on top of the 10 rage from the base ability Tactical Mastery). Since Blizzard's note of 2.11. only 3 ranks (previously 5 ranks with 3–15 rage).
Beißt das Ziel: 100 % normaler Schaden p: Bites the target: 100 % normal damage plus 42 and lots of threat. 31-point talent for bears (requires Leader of the Pack), 3 ranks.
Belegt ein verbündetes Ziel 30 Sek. lang: Places Light's Vigil on a friendly target for 30 sec. Your next Holy Shock on that target has no cooldown and heals the target and its party for 325 to 344. Only one Vigil per Paladin can be active on each party. Now only works on allies (the attack part was removed).
Berserker (Angriffstempo auf Knopfdruck,: Berserking (attack speed at the push of a button, since Nov. 2 15 sec instead of 10) and Beast Slaying (more damage against beasts) – strong while leveling.
Berserker (mehr Angriffs- und Zaubertemp: Berserking (more attack and casting speed, now 15 sec) helps every spec, plus Regeneration and Beast Slaying.
Berserker gibt 10 % Zaubertempo als Burs: Berserking gives 10 % casting speed as a burst (since Nov. 2 15 sec instead of 10). Rapid Regeneration* helps with survival together with Ice Barrier or Mana Shield.
Berserker, Verbesserte Wandlungskraft* u: Berserk, Improved Shifting Power* and Gift of the Earthmother were removed on 30.10. (confirmed by Blizzard on Nov. 2). New are Lacerate and Predatory Discipline* (Feral Combat) as well as Bloom* (Restoration).
Berserker: +10 % Angriffstempo für 15 Se: Berserking: +10 % attack speed for 15 sec (since 2.11., previously 10 sec); Regeneration (20 % in combat) and Rapid Regeneration help while leveling.
Beste PvP-Wahl: Überlebenswille* (Will t: Best PvP choice: Will to Survive* removes stuns, Ruthless* gives +1% critical strike chance (previously 2%).
Bester Tank für Dungeons und Raids, viel: Best tank for dungeons and raids, lots of tank talents; since 2.11. Defensive Stance gives 80 % more threat
Blitz, der auf bis zu 3 Gegner übersprin: Lightning that jumps to up to 3 enemies. 2,5 sec cast time, about 145 % of Lightning Bolt's damage on the first target, but about 225 % of the mana cost. For groups.
Blitzbeherrschung mit Schmuckstücken: sc: Lightning Mastery with trinkets: faster Lightning Bolts and Chain Lightning without cooldown.

Bär: 100 % mehr Wut durch kritische Tref: Bear: 100 % more rage from critical hits. Bear and Dire Bear Form now generate 115 % more threat (previously 50 %) – to make up for Blessing of Salvation being removed.
Bärengestalt gibt viel Rüstung und Leben: Bear Form gives lots of armor and health – good for surviving melee enemies (Furor is now in Feral Combat and is missing from this build).
Chance auf zusätzliche Angriffe mit Bonu: Chance for extra attacks with bonus attack power. From 30 the main imbue for Enhancement. The extra hit now has its own animation.
Danach Wirbelwind (mit Verbesserter Wirb: Then Whirlwind (2 sec shorter cooldown with Improved Whirlwind*).
Dein Dämon hat seit dem 2.11. nur noch 2: Since 2.11. your demon only gets 2 health per point of your Stamina. Don't let the Voidwalker hold several enemies at once – send extra enemies away with Fear and heal him in time with Health Funnel.
Der Dämon steht im Mittelpunkt, hält Geg: The demon is the centerpiece, holds enemies in place and deals lots of damage. Very comfortable, e.g. with Soul Link – but since 2.11. demons have much less health, so keep an eye on their health.
Der Standard zum Leveln. Mit einer langs: The standard for leveling. With a slow two-handed weapon, Flurry (up to 30 % haste) and Stormstrike (now every 6 sec) you hit hard. Maelstrom Weapon now charges twice as often and gives you instant Lightning Bolts or heals. Talent rework of Nov. 2 announced – preliminary.
The classic group and raid healer. Prayer of Mending, Holy Binding* and Spiritual Guidance make your healing strong. Soul Warding from Discipline gives you shields more often. Preliminary.
Die Endspiel-Version von Kampf: Stahlbli: The endgame version of Combat: Flash of Steel* for more energy from Shank*, Weapon Expertise against dodge and parry, plus in Assassination Improved Slice and Dice, Lethality, Vigor and Cold Blood (preliminary, talent rework announced).
Die Leveling-Reihenfolge ist eine eigene: The leveling order is my own compilation from the sources' recommendations: Stormstrike at 25, Improved Ghost Wolf right after (since Nov. 2 only in tier 4, so no longer before level 20), Rage of the Farseer* at 40 (method.gg) and the talent list from wow.gg (Thundering Strikes, Mental Dexterity*, Improved Ghost Wolf, Shamanistic Focus) – preliminary.
Die Reihenfolge (Waffen 31 / Furor 20) b: The order (Arms 31 / Fury 20) is based on ForeverWisp (marked there as untested theory) and was adjusted to Blizzard's note of 2.11. – preliminary.
Die Reihenfolge holt Verstümmeln mit Stu: The order gets Mutilate at level 40 – before that you play with Sinister Strike and Shank*.
Die Reihenfolge setzt zuerst alles in Ka: The order puts everything into Combat first: Blade Flurry at level 30, Flash of Steel* from level 36 (Shank* comes at 24) and Adrenaline Rush at level 40. After that come the Assassination talents of the first three tiers (final distribution 14/37/0).
Die Tank-Skillung für Dungeons und Raids: The tank spec for dungeons and raids. Thick Hide gives lots of armor, Natural Reaction gives dodge and rage. Lacerate (now a talent) and Primal Bite* together with Bear Form's 115 % threat bonus provide lots of threat.
Die Wurzel von Erfrierung unterliegt jet: The root from Frostbite is now subject to diminishing returns (DR). Ignite works correctly with Flamestrike again.
Die Wurzel von Verbesserte Kniesehne unt: The root from Improved Hamstring is subject to diminishing returns (DR) – don't rely on keeping targets rooted all the time.
Die bekannte 31/20-Waffen/Furor-Skillung: The well-known 31/20 Arms/Fury spec for PvP. Mortal Strike halves healing, Improved Hamstring holds enemies in place. Fury adds crit, rage and Reckless Swings* (adjusted to the changes of 2.11., preliminary).
Die klassische Leveln-Skillung mit große: The classic leveling spec with a big two-handed weapon. Rend, Deep Wounds and Overpower deal lots of damage, and Mortal Strike joins at level 40. Improved Slam makes Slam a good rage dump. After that you go into Fury for more crit, rage and Reckless Swings* (adjusted to the changes of 2.11., preliminary).
Direkter Waffenschaden mit Finsterer Sto: Direct weapon damage with Sinister Strike and Eviscerate. Sturdy thanks to Deflection, Riposte and Lightning Reflexes. Works with any weapon type (Hack and Slash). Blade Flurry brings damage on two targets, Flash of Steel* turns Shank* into an energy source.
Dornen auf dich, mit voller Energie Schl: Thorns on yourself, Prowl with full energy (from 32, Poised* saves 10 energy).
Du erhältst Angriffskraft in Höhe von 50: You gain attack power equal to 50/100/150 % of your Intellect.
Du heilst mit Welle der Heilung, Geringe: You heal with Healing Wave, Lesser Healing Wave, Chain Heal and the new Riptide (heal over time). Water Shield and totems keep your mana up.
Du kämpfst mit einer Zweihandwaffe (oder: You fight with a two-handed weapon (or weapon + shield), boosted by weapon enchantments. Stormstrike (now every 6 sec), shocks and instant Lightning Bolts via Maelstrom Weapon keep the gameplay varied.
Du stehst auf Abstand und wirkst Blitzsc: You stand at range and cast Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Flame Shock. Lightning Overload, Call of Thunder and Lightning Mastery make lightning your main weapon. High damage per hit, but heavy mana use.
Durchhaltevermögen: +5 % Gesundheit (sei: Endurance: +5 % health (since 2.11. without crit damage bonus); War Stomp stuns up to 5 enemies for 2 sec – good for tanking. Tauren Warriors now correctly have +5 Strength compared to Humans.
Dämon losschicken, damit er die Aufmerks: Send your demon in so it gets the enemy's attention. Since 2.11. it can take less – keep an eye on its health and use Health Funnel in time.
Dämonen als Blocker (Leerwandler) oder S: Demons as blockers (Voidwalker) or damage dealers (Succubus/Incubus); they grow with your gear, but since 2.11. they can take much less.
Dämonen haben seit dem 2.11. viel wenige: Since 2.11. demons have much less health – with Soul Link it dies faster
Dämonen sind seit dem 2.11. deutlich wen: Since 2.11. demons are much less durable (2 health per point of the Warlock's Stamina instead of 7,5) – even the Voidwalker can't tank as long anymore.
Dämonen wachsen mit deinen Werten und de: Demons grow with your stats and gear – but since 2.11. they only get 2 health per point of your Stamina (previously 7,5) and can take much less.
Eher PvP-Spec; der PvE-Wert von Todesmal: More of a PvP spec; the PvE value of Death Mark* is still open (preliminary).
Ein Mischbuild aus 30 Punkten Wilder Kam: A hybrid build with 30 points in Feral Combat and 21 points in Restoration. You get Leader of the Pack and Predatory Discipline* for cat, plus Furor, Heart of the Wild, Swiftmend and Nature's Swiftness.

Einhandwaffe und Schild, viel Verteidigu: One-handed weapon and shield, lots of defense and threat. Shield Slam and Bastion* deal damage, and blocking brings rage in Forever. Since 2.11. Defensive Stance gives 80 % more threat and Defiance up to 20 %. Preliminary state.

Entfesselt sofort die Energie eures akti: Instantly unleashes the energy of your active seal on an enemy without consuming the seal. The effect depends on the seal. Does not share a cooldown with Judgement.

Gold medal talent (11 points, now tier 3), active: your next Flash of Light, Holy Light or Holy Shock is guaranteed to crit.

Endspiel-Raids ab 9. Dezember: Barrow De: Endgame raids from December 9: Barrow Deeps* (10), Hyjal Summit (20), Onyxia's Lair (40)
Dungeons: Seit dem Hotfix vom 8. Novembe: Dungeons: Since the November 8 hotfix, enemies in dungeons give 50% more experience when killed (Blizzard blue post). According to Blizzard, that puts them at about 60% of Classic Era values. Dungeon quests are still worth it.
Neue Dungeons: Hall of Thanes* (13–18, u: New dungeons: Hall of Thanes* (13–18, beneath Ironforge), Ruins of Lordaeron* (15–20, above Undercity), Excavation Site* (24–29, Wetlands), City of Dalaran* (28–33, Alterac Mountains), The Drowned City* (35–40, off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale), Krol'Dok Stronghold* (Riverglades*), Alcaz Prison* (48–53, Dustwallow Marsh), Blackmaw Hold* (55–60, Azshara) and Shaper's Terrace* (58–60, Un'Goro Crater). There is no dungeon finder with teleport – you walk there yourselves.
Raids: Am 9. Dezember öffnen Barrow Deep: Raids: Barrow Deeps* (10 players), Hyjal Summit (20 players) and Onyxia's Lair (40 players) open on December 9.
Reiten: Ab Stufe 40 lernst du beim Reitl: Riding: From level 40 you learn it from your race's riding trainer for 100 gold – your first mount is included. At "Honored" with your capital you get a 10% discount. Epic from level 60: 1,000 gold for the riding skill plus 200 gold for the mount. Warlocks and paladins get their mount and riding skill through their class quest and save the 100 gold. Since November 10, racial mounts from vendors are bind on pickup.
Händlerpreise: Mit dem Reset am 10. Nove: Vendor prices: With the November 10 reset, Blizzard lowered the vendor sell prices of many crafted items (e.g. Iron Grenades and some crafted armor). Buying materials from a vendor, crafting and selling the result back to a vendor no longer pays off.
Dunkelmond-Jahrmarkt: zum ersten Mal ab: Darkmoon Faire: for the first time from November 9, for one week in Elwynn Forest near Goldshire. After that, according to MeinMMO, it alternates monthly with Mulgore (next date December 7). Sayge's buff works in the open world in Forever, but not in raids.
Server und Bevölkerung: Seit dem 9. Nove: Servers and population: Since November 9, crowded zones are less full, more so on PvP servers. On PvP servers, Blizzard temporarily limits character creation per faction to keep Horde and Alliance balanced.
Legendär: Die erste legendäre Waffe ist: Legendary: The first legendary weapon is Taldramir, the Whispering Wood* (two-handed staff with a druid theme). Blizzard has not yet revealed how to get it.
Was noch kommt: Hardcore-Server folgen s: What is coming: Hardcore servers will follow later; there is no date yet. Blizzard plans major updates about every four months; the first is expected in spring 2027.
Kopie eines Gebiets: Ist es voll, vertei: Copy of a zone: when it is full, the game spreads players across several layers. When you join a group, Forever asks when you want to switch to your group's world.
In Forever wählst du keinen einzelnen Se: In Forever you do not pick a single server but a ruleset: Normal, PvP, Roleplay or Roleplay-PvP. It is fixed for the character.

Alles zuerst in Dämonologie: Unheilige M: Everything into Demonology first: Unholy Power, Fel Vitality and Demonic Energies* make your demon strong early, from level 30 Soul Link redirects 30% of your damage to it, and at 40 you already have Demonic Pact (sacrifice the imp, +15% Shadow damage). The remaining 20 points go into Affliction: Improved Corruption, Suppression, Improved Drains*, Pandemic and Amplify Curse.
Wenn du alleine levelst und lieber siche: If you level solo and prefer to play safely without breaks. Especially good from level 30 once Soul Link is available – and a good base for the Demonology spec at 60.
Seelenverbindung schon ab Stufe 30: du h: Soul Link from level 30: you can take a lot of damage
Dämonischer Pakt schon mit 40 (+15 % Sch: Demonic Pact already at 40 (+15% Shadow damage)
Starker, schwer zu tötender Dämon – kaum: Strong demon that is hard to kill – hardly any breaks
Ab 41 macht Verbesserte Verderbnis Verde: From 41, Improved Corruption makes Corruption instant
Bis Stufe 30 etwas langsamer als Gebrech: A bit slower than Affliction until level 30
Verderbnis bleibt bis Stufe 45 ein Zaube: Corruption keeps a cast time until level 45
Ab Stufe 25 (Dämonisches Brandmal*): Sen: From level 25 (Demonic Brand*): Searing Pain in between – your demon's next attacks deal more damage.
Ab Stufe 30 schützt dich Seelenverbindun: From level 30, Soul Link protects you: part of the damage goes to the demon – keep an eye on its health and heal it with Health Funnel.
Bist du schon höher als 10, beim Hexenme: If you are already above level 10, unlearn your talents at the warlock trainer (1 gold the first time) and redistribute them in this order.
Dämonische Opferung erst ab Stufe 40 mit: Only use Demonic Sacrifice from level 40 with Demonic Pact – before that you lose the demon and with it Soul Link.
Im siikk-Talentplaner (/tp import) kanns: In the siikk Talent Planner (/tp import) you can take over this build with the "Code for the addon" button in the talent tree.
Gold und Auktionshaus: Seit dem Hotfix v: Gold and auction house: Since the November 10 hotfix, most quests from level 48 on additionally reward gold. At level 60, however, quests are not converted into gold, according to Blizzard. The lowered minimum auction house deposit (1 copper instead of 1 silver) was temporarily rolled back by Blizzard on November 12 – it is set to arrive with the November 17 maintenance.
Stoffrüstung und Taschen. Für Magier, Pr: Cloth armor and bags. For mages, priests and warlocks; bags always sell. Since the November 11 hotfix, several bags have more slots (Green/Red Woolen Bag 10, Green/Black Silk Pack 12, Red Mageweave Bag 14) but need one more bolt of cloth.
Hotfix vom 11. November: Richturteil gil: Hotfix from November 11: Judgement now counts as a ranged attack – it uses your ranged hit chance and no longer triggers melee item effects.
Hotfix vom 11. November: Zwielichtfokus: Hotfix from November 11: Twilight Focus now also works in Shadowform, and Gnomes can use Confounding Flash in Shadowform.
